## Real app. Real agent. Really running.

## An agent that outlives the browser tab.

### Any device, zero install

A web app that lives on your home screen. Phone, laptop, borrowed browser — same agent, same memory, same files.

### Always on

Your agent runs in its own isolated cloud machine. Long tasks keep going and routines fire on time — laptop closed.

### Your apps, connected

Gmail, Notion, Slack, calendars and more via MCP connectors — with per-connector permissions you control.

### Real work, not just chat

A genuine shell, filesystem, and browser automation. It writes files, runs code, browses — and shows every step.

### Open source

Apache-licensed and self-hostable. Your agent, your data, your infra. No lock-in, ever.

### Isolated by design

One dedicated micro-VM per user. Your keys and connectors never share a machine with anyone else’s.

## Connect and go.

### Sign in

One click — email or Google. Your private agent machine spins up in seconds.

### Connect

Drop in an API key — Anthropic, OpenAI, Fireworks, OpenRouter, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

### Delegate

Describe the task. Watch the steps. Get notified when it’s done — wherever you are.

## Plugged into your world.

Krowoc speaks MCP — the open connector standard — so your agent works inside the tools you already use.

### Your apps

Via MCP connectors (Composio, Klavis, Zapier MCP, or any endpoint) — with per-connector permissions.

### Your models

Your keys, your models, your spend — switch anytime, we never mark up tokens.

### Its own hands

Built in, no setup: a real machine your agent works on — every step visible.

## Any model. Your terms.

Krowoc routes to whatever intelligence you prefer — and your costs stay yours.

### Top-10 lineup, one key

Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, DeepSeek V4, MiniMax M3 and friends — paste one Fireworks or OpenRouter key and get the whole picker.

### Claude, full power

The Claude Agent SDK — shell, files, browsing, skills — running on your own Anthropic API key.

### OpenAI & beyond

Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including local Ollama. Keys live on your private machine, never in a shared database.

## The cloud your agent deserves.

Sign up and your private cloud machine spins up in about a minute.
